name: codex-eval-plugin
description: Explicitly requested headless evaluation tests comparing Codex with Claude Code and/or GitHub Copilot.

interface.longDescription: Invoke only when the user explicitly wants to run evaluation tests comparing Codex against another coding agent. Discover workflows, approve tasks, run native Codex, Claude Code and optional GitHub Copilot, and inspect measured results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $evaluate to compare Codex with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or both on my software development workflows.
